description: 한국중부발전(주)_발전소 건설현황 정보 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국중부발전(주). “발전소 건설현황” API는 한국중부발전(주)이 제공하는 공공데이터 서비스로, 각 발전소의 건설 진행 상황을 월 단위로 문서 형식으로 조회할 수 있는 기능을 제공합니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국중부발전(주). Its tags are 중부발전, 건설, 현황, 시공현황, 공정자료. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-08-25 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
